title: All the while
titleEn: Using All the while for a continuing or simultaneous situation

omissions: English versions of Chinese-only Important Rules are faithful editorial translations.

formulas.formula: Subject + verb + all the while + time clause
Main situation, but all the while + subject + verb

example: He stayed calm all the while, even when the discussion turned hostile.
exampleZh: 即使討論變得充滿敵意，他始終保持冷靜。

examples.en: He stayed calm all the while, even when the discussion turned hostile.
examples.zh: 即使討論變得充滿敵意，他始終保持冷靜。
examples.highlight: He stayed calm all the while, even when the discussion turned hostile.

rules.zh: 「All the while」表示甚麼？ All the while 表示某個動作、狀態或情況在一段指定時間內一直持續。 例： （經理說話期間，她一直聆聽。） 它通常描述一段特定時間，而不是一個人的長期習慣。
rules.en: All the while means that an action, state or situation continues throughout a specified period—from beginning to end. For example: She listened all the while the manager was speaking. It normally describes a particular period, not a person's long-term habit.
examples: from the beginning to the end。
She listened all the while the manager was speaking.

rules.zh: 可以連接兩件同時發生的事情 All the while 經常表示一件事情發生時，另一件事情在整段時間內持續進行。 （孩子們玩耍期間，父母一直看着他們。）
rules.en: All the while can link two things happening at the same time. It often shows that while one event was taking place, another action or situation continued throughout the whole period, as in The children played all the while their parents watched them.
examples: The children played all the while their parents watched them.

rules.zh: 可以揭示未被察覺的情況 當 all the while 放在第二個分句中，它經常表示某個情況一直存在，只是其他人當時沒有察覺。 （他看起來很有信心，但其實一直非常緊張。） 這種用法在故事、描述和解釋中尤其常見。
rules.en: All the while can reveal an unnoticed situation. In a second clause, it often shows that something had existed throughout although others did not notice it at the time: He appeared confident, but all the while he was extremely nervous. This use is especially common in stories, descriptions and explanations.
examples: He appeared confident, but all the while he was extremely nervous.

rules.zh: 「All the while」與相似句型的分別 表示某件事情在整段時間內一直發生。 （她由始至終都保持冷靜。） 表示某件事情的程度因另一項因素而進一步增加，意思是「更加……」。 （過程的困難令這次成功更加有意義。） 它描述的是程度增加，而不是動作持續的時間。 表示某項情況令我們有更充分的理由採取某個行動。 （這條路很危險，所以我們更有理由小心駕駛。） 它表達的是更強的理由，不是「一直」。 表示「儘管如此」或「即使如此」，用來引出與前文形成讓步或轉折的內容。 （旅程令人疲倦。儘管如此，我們仍然很享受。） 它表達的是讓步或轉折，不是時間上的持續。
rules.en: Distinguish All the while from similar structures. All the while means that something continues throughout a period: She remained calm all the while. All the more + adjective/adverb increases the degree of a quality or manner, as in The difficulty made the success all the more meaningful; it concerns degree, not duration. All the more reason to ... says that a situation creates stronger justification for an action, as in The road is dangerous, so that is all the more reason to drive carefully; it expresses a reason, not “throughout”. All the same means “nevertheless” or “even so” and introduces a concession or contrast, as in The journey was tiring. All the same, we enjoyed it; it does not describe duration.
examples: She remained calm all the while.
The difficulty made the success all the more meaningful.
The road is dangerous, so that is all the more reason to drive carefully.
The journey was tiring. All the same, we enjoyed it.

benefits.zh: 清楚表示事情由始至終都在發生 這個句型能清楚說明某個動作或情況在一段時間內由始至終都沒有停止。
benefits.en: This structure helps you show that an action or condition continued throughout a particular period.

benefits.zh: 自然連接兩件同時發生的事情 你可以用它說明：當一件事情發生時，另一個動作或情況一直持續。 （職員檢查問題期間，乘客一直等候。）
benefits.en: You can use it to show what continued while another event was taking place. The passengers waited all the while the staff were checking the problem.
examples: You can use it to show what continued while another event was taking place.
The passengers waited all the while the staff were checking the problem.

benefits.zh: 幫助揭示表面之下的真實情況 它可以用來揭示某個一直存在、但其他人當時沒有察覺的情況。 （他在面試期間一直微笑，但其實一直很擔心。） 第二個版本更自然地突出了「外表」與「真實情況」之間的分別。
benefits.en: It can show that one situation was secretly or unexpectedly continuing behind another situation. He smiled throughout the interview, but he was worried the whole time. He smiled during the interview, but all the while he was worried.
examples: It can show that one situation was secretly or unexpectedly continuing behind another situation.
He smiled throughout the interview, but he was worried the whole time.
He smiled during the interview, but all the while he was worried.

benefits.zh: 避免重複使用 throughout 或 the whole time 你不需要經常重複使用 throughout、during the entire period 或 the whole time，也可以自然表達 「整段時間」。
benefits.en: Instead of repeatedly using throughout, during the entire period or the whole time, you can use all the while.

benefits.zh: 令故事和描述更有連貫性 這個句型適合用來描述兩件同時發展的事情，令故事、報告和口頭敘述更加連貫。
benefits.en: It makes stories and descriptions more coherent. The structure is useful for describing two events that develop at the same time, giving stories, reports and oral narratives a clearer flow.
examples: The structure is useful when describing two events that develop at the same time.

sourceOmissions: English versions of Chinese-only Important Rules are faithful editorial translations.
